name: HM07
description: Attacks the foe with enough power to climb waterfalls.

gifts.note: After the Groudon and Kyogre crisis. Once Rayquaza has calmed Groudon and Kyogre and you have spoken to both Maxie and Archie in Sootopolis City, Wallace waits in front of the Gym and gives you HM Waterfall. He blocks the Gym until you talk to him, so it can't be missed.
